At least 18 people booked at Fayette County facility on July 18
By
J. T. RomanoAt least 18 people were booked at a Fayette County, Kentucky, facility on July 18, 2026.
The "Other" category appeared in six listed-charge entries; the "Property" and "Warrant" categories each appeared in five; the "Drug" category appeared in four; and the "Traffic" category appeared in three. The most common listed charge was "FAILURE TO APPEAR, CITATION FOR MISDEMEANOR," appearing in five charge entries. The listed charge "DISORDERLY CONDUCT, 2ND DEGREE" appeared in three charge entries.
Booking records show charges as listed at the time of booking. Individuals listed have not been convicted of any charges based on this record.
